reason: We already pay for Claude and Codex cloud agents and their built-in scheduling does the job well enough. I am not adding another tool, another $99 a month and a pre-alpha dependency built by one person to my client work.
objection: A failed or looping run burns our agent quota overnight and nobody notices until the morning. A pre-alpha tool from one developer makes that more likely, not less.
would_change_my_mind: Hard spend and retry caps per run that stop a looping agent, plus proof from other agencies that it ran for months without surprises.
